name: io.github.Kx96xx/tshark-mcp
title: tshark-mcp
description: Read-only packet capture analysis with tshark: Diameter, GTP, SIP, RTP, SIGTRAN, DNS, TCP and TLS.

environmentVariables.name: TSHARK_MCP_ALLOW_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Directories the server may read captures from, colon-separated. Required: the server refuses to start without one.

environmentVariables.name: TSHARK_MCP_TSHARK
environmentVariables.description: Path to the tshark binary (4.0 or newer) when it is not on PATH.

environmentVariables.name: TSHARK_MCP_REDACT
environmentVariables.description: Pseudonymise identifiers in every result: ids (IMSI, MSISDN, IMEI, SIP users, UE IPs) or ids+ips (every IP too).

environmentVariables.name: TSHARK_MCP_EXPORT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Turns on export_subset: the one directory it may write new pcapng files to. Must not overlap an allowed dir. Unset: the server writes nothing.
